predecessors.name: Sultanate of Brunei
predecessors.text: 'a territory spanning from the westernmost point of Sarawak, Tanjung Datu, to the Samarahan river', granted to James Brooke on 24 September 1841

successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: Sarawak, ceded by Vyner Brooke to the British government as a Crown colony on 1 July 1946

ledger.x: 1841: Brunei grants Sarawak to James Brooke, who becomes its first Rajah.
1841: the Kuching country passes from Brunei to Brooke.
1852: the new Sultan cedes Saribas and Skrang.
1861: Brooke acquires the Rajang River basin.

c. 1870: page silent. Cliopatria adds 95 cells in 1870 (111.1-114.7E, 1.4-4.3N); neither the Raj page nor the History of Sarawak page dates or names a gain between Bintulu (1861) and Baram (1882), so the year is Cliopatria's and the cedant is assumed.
1885: Brunei agrees to cede the Trusan valley.
1888: Sarawak becomes a British protected state.
1946: the protected state ends with the cession.
1946: Vyner Brooke cedes Sarawak to Britain.

wars.name: Rentap's rebellion
wars.outcome: The first of the rebellions the Raj page lists: 'Three major rebellions led by Rentap (1853)'.

wars.name: Chinese insurrection (Liu Shan Bang)
wars.outcome: 'Conflicts ensued between the government and the Chinese in 1857' (Raj page); the page does not name Bau in that sentence and gives no territory or result.

wars.name: Syarif Masahor's rebellion
wars.outcome: Listed by the Raj page among the rebellions (Rentap 1853, Liu Shan Bang 1857, Syarif Masahor 1860); no territory or result is given.

wars.name: Japanese invasion and occupation of Sarawak
wars.outcome: Japan occupied all of Sarawak for three years and eight months; the Japanese surrendered on 10 September 1945 and a British Military Administration ran the land until April 1946.

certainty.note: The cessions of 1852, 1861, 1882, 1885, 1890 and 1905 were by treaty or annexation of river basins, and the pages give no survey line; the interior frontier with Dutch Borneo and North Borneo is not described on any page opened.
